name: Copernicus Sentinel-2
role: Detected intertidal macroalgae proxy and RGB context
licence: Copernicus free, full and open use with attribution
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022), processed by the project
limits: Species-agnostic, unvalidated extent. Water-stretched RGB with land masked grey. No contemporary subtidal kelp detection.

name: NPWS marine communities
licence: NPWS Open Data policy (CC BY 4.0 default); source-specific usage notes apply
attribution: National Parks and Wildlife Service, Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage
limits: Mapped/interpolated historical community, not a 2025 field survey. Original OSi basemap is not reproduced. Exact survey date per polygon unavailable.

name: INFOMAR
role: Cell depth and habitat model bathymetry
attribution: Contains Irish Public Sector Data (Geological Survey Ireland and Marine Institute), CC BY 4.0
limits: LAT vertical datum; cell centre depth does not resolve within-cell relief or tidal water depth.

name: Copernicus Marine IBI wave reanalysis
role: Offshore wave climate and directional scenario
licence: Copernicus Marine Service licence, free use with attribution
attribution: E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information; NOWSystems and MeteoFrance
limits: Nearest wet model point offshore. No local refraction, shoaling, breaking or hazard validation.

name: EMODnet Bathymetry
licence: CC BY 4.0 for EMODnet-created data products; source metadata governs exceptions
attribution: EMODnet Bathymetry Consortium; an EU-owned data product, licensed under CC BY 4.0
limits: Local cached raster resampled to about 290 × 464 m; context only.

name: Burrows wave-fetch raster
dates: 2020 dataset, 200 m UK and Ireland grid
licence: CC BY 4.0, exact local TIFF MD5 matched Figshare metadata on 13 October 2026
attribution: Michael T. Burrows, Wave fetch GIS layers for the UK and Ireland at 200m scale
limits: Geometric exposure proxy, not significant wave height.

name: OpenStreetMap
dates: Coastline caches August and October 2026; assets October 2026
limits: Incomplete mapping. Object counts can include related parts of one physical asset. OSM-derived feature collections retain ODbL obligations.

name: EPA Water Framework Directive
licence: CC BY 4.0 for EPA-produced data; no OSi base mapping reproduced
limits: Macroalgae element available only for two cycles up to 2010–2015. No measurement of this kelp bed's extent or biomass.

name: OBIS Marine Recorder snapshots and Schoenrock et al.
licence: CC BY 4.0 verified for the three contributing occurrence datasets and the reference paper
attribution: JNCC, National Museums Northern Ireland, SeaSearch, Marine Biological Association / DASSH, OBIS; Schoenrock et al. (2020)
limits: 14 of 17 reference taxa across 35 West Cork sites. Regional presence is effort-biased, not ecological health. All 1,854 contributing records trace to the three dataset licences below.

name: Dubi & Tørum laboratory study
attribution: Dubi, A. and Tørum, A., Wave Energy Dissipation in Kelp Vegetation
limits: Artificial plants, 4–10 m full-scale depth, reference density/morphology and periods. Depth interpolation and polygon-ray integration are project choices.

name: OPW approved minor-works funding
licence: Public numeric funding records cited; no flood geometry copied
attribution: Office of Public Works, Wexford county funding records
limits: Three selected interventions at one Seaview site. Nominal approved grants, not out-turn costs or Cork design quotes. Service equivalence, least cost and demand unproven.

name: OPW flood extents
licence: Reuse clearance unresolved; restricted layers withheld
limits: No OPW flood geometry, overlap flag, flood-derived feature styling or derivative visual is shipped.

name: NOAA OISST v2.1
role: Regional temperature context from a small NOAA subset
licence: Free use and redistribution with NOAA disclaimer
attribution: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
limits: Sparse surface-temperature sample averages, not annual climatological means, seabed temperatures, heatwave diagnoses or kelp-loss measurements.

name: Leaflet 1.9.4
limits: Optional OSM online tiles obey provider policy; no bulk or offline tile download.

name: Marine Recorder Snapshot extract of surveys entered by SeaSearch
dates: Dataset v2.1, published January 2022; historical surveys
licence: CC BY 4.0, OBIS dataset intellectualrights verified 13 October 2026
attribution: SeaSearch (2021): Marine Recorder Snapshot extract of surveys entered by SeaSearch. v2.1. Marine Biological Association. Dataset/Samplingevent. https://doi.org/10.17031/yq0gbg
limits: The local indicator uses co-located survey records; no contemporary habitat condition is inferred.

name: Marine Recorder Snapshot extract of surveys entered by JNCC
dates: Dataset v2.1, published January 2022; historical surveys
licence: CC BY 4.0, OBIS dataset intellectualrights verified 13 October 2026
attribution: Joint Nature Conservation Committee (JNCC) (2021): Marine Recorder Snapshot extract of surveys entered by JNCC. v2.1. Marine Biological Association. Dataset/Samplingevent. https://doi.org/10.17031/mehqrq
limits: The local indicator uses co-located survey records; no contemporary habitat condition is inferred.

name: Marine Recorder Snapshot extract of surveys entered by National Museums Northern Ireland (NMNI)
dates: Dataset v2.1, published January 2022; historical surveys
licence: CC BY 4.0, OBIS dataset intellectualrights verified 13 October 2026
attribution: National Museums Northern Ireland (NMNI) (2021): Marine Recorder Snapshot extract of surveys entered by National Museums Northern Ireland (NMNI). v2.1. Marine Biological Association. Dataset/Samplingevent. https://doi.org/10.17031/frdvov
limits: The local indicator uses co-located survey records; no contemporary habitat condition is inferred.
